baseline_Platform_classification_explana.Actuator_difference: The current madeByActuator mapping lacks that direct CCO has_agent inclusion; the same derivation is unavailable. Its non-subsumption by Platform is independently reasoner-tested.
proof: Their mapping expressions require a bearer_of witness that has a realization in Observation or Sampling.
Native source Observation/Sampling require exactly one madeBySensor/madeBySampler filler, restricted to Sensor/Sampler, which are SSN Systems.
The preserved madeBySensor/madeBySampler subproperty mapping to CCO has_agent, itself subproperty of BFO has_participant, supplies a System participant in that realization.
The preserved bearer_of o has_realization o has_participant subPropertyOf hosts chain therefore supplies hosts some System.
System all isHostedBy Platform plus hosts inverseOf isHostedBy classifies the original host as Platform.
